variant.title: Anti-Taxicab
variant.description: A digit cannot repeat exactly its own Manhattan distance away.
rule_guide.title: Anti-Taxicab Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box contains no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: If a cell contains X, another cell exactly X Manhattan-distance steps away cannot also contain X.
rule_guide.item_3: Manhattan distance is the number of horizontal and vertical steps between two cells. For example, two cells three steps apart cannot both contain 3.
